text: The team decided to remove Teletext functionality from the product, and ensure the corporate identity is clear in the remote design with logo and branding colors placed top-left.

There is a potential conflict about feature priorities across age groups that could lead to scope ambiguity, which will be addressed by defining target users as 16-40 with two function layers and a simpler remote for elderly.

The UI will design the LCD screen function menu with a multi-page layout and there will be two menus (button and LCD/options) with the screen on top in the remote layout; layout of the remote designed by ID.
The UI designer will create maps of the data gathered for the project; and there is a need to integrate screen with speech recognition.
Ownership/department boundaries are unclear for logo/microphone decisions, and MTD022ID's computer is not functioning properly and their screen is reduced in size.
